fusions.name: Banked Lunge
fusions.desc: A lunge out of stillness that deals 34 damage, leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds and sets it [Burning] for 6 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Death Roll
fusions.desc: Thrashes in a ring of flame, which deals 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, stuns each for 1 second and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Sleeping Cinder
fusions.desc: Buries a banked coal at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and when an enemy comes within 2 tiles it bursts and deals 22 damage.

fusions.name: Basking Heat
fusions.desc: In daylight, your damage rises by 12%. You have 10% fire resistance.
